description: Rules of the game's sound driver. Sounds are named as in sounds/sounds.json, event flags as in flags.json, maps by map name; voice lines are row numbers of config/sound_tables.json xa_lines. Volumes are 0..127. fixed_voices maps a sound name to the hardware voice it always keys (voice 0..23, and its "fine" value 0..255): these are the radio loops, which their update restarts, so the positional loop sustain never replays them.

commands.description: Sound command numbers: bank loads start at first_bank (one per row of sound_tables.json "files"); ambient banks first_ambient..last_ambient carry their own reverb depth; song command c loads files[song_file_offset + c] and bank command c + song_bank_offset; fade_out_* are the fade commands.

music.description: Bank slot of the music instruments, the music volume while a song plays and while a voice line ducks it.

voice_lines.description: Volume of voice lines: default_volume, and per line an override; scaled lines follow the effects volume of the options (the finale's boss lines and the phone call), the others play at their own level.

ambient_overrides.description: The Old Silent Hill streets change their ambience once the town is past its first visit (later_flags set).
